description: Public JSON Schema contract for where each package of a workspace sits, read from the workspace root, and the published schema it is written against: a key ending in `/` is a package's own directory whose value is that package's documents, checked by its package schema; any other key is a document the workspace holds directly. It holds locations only. Other files a workspace carries are outside this schema. Source of truth: analitiq.contracts.workspace.Workspace (Pydantic).
title: Analitiq Workspace
